scope: Provisional appearance-only per-role assessment of the rebuilt Bubble Duel. No averaged score and no authoritative master-audit PASS.
score_definition: Judgement of silhouette, painted contours, values/palette, recognizable storybook identity and readability in the listed desktop states. All dimensions must reach 4.6; 5.0 requires owner acceptance.

assets.name: Pool room
assets.role: Arena and menus at 1280x720, 1600x720 and 960x720
assets.observation: Symmetric fill, continuous pool and complete controls. Existing 1024x576 runtime/source-resolution debt remains a separate technical limitation; this appearance score does not accept native coverage.

assets.name: Bubble
assets.role: Five purchased tints, practice target and opponent
assets.observation: Broad pearly highlight replaces mottling. Peach rival differs from five player swatches; dark contour and visible tethers retain ownership. Source transparent RGB fringe has negligible alpha and is absent in scene composites.

assets.name: Marlo swimming
assets.role: Hub card and swimming opponent
assets.observation: Four complete horizontal paddle poses, stable scale and torso, cream face and warm-brown authored contours. All four cells inspected; loop timing is five poses per second. Whole-motion human/device acceptance remains pending.

assets.name: Pearl collectible
assets.role: Current Ride card and targets
assets.observation: Simple ivory orb separates from the water. Pickup disappears for 0.9 seconds and neighbours retain continuous motion.

assets.name: Water burst
assets.role: Contact feedback
assets.observation: Enlarged 155px burst and expanding pearl reward make the short event visible. Correct surviving bubble is retained.

assets.name: Picture pointer
assets.role: First-action guidance
assets.observation: Large warm pointing hand remains distinct from both water and bubble rim; direction points at an actual reachable target.

assets.name: Navigation card
assets.role: Back, shop page and large repeat-arrow controls
assets.observation: Consistent painted shell frame; clear arrows and complete corners. The 176px repeat control uses a 72px glyph and needs no reading.

evidence_policy: PNGs and source sheets are diagnostic. Synthetic review pearls are declared; all purchases use real controls. Saves are isolated. No protected original changed. No finding closed.
history: Initial fresh-process reload failed 5/9 checks because JSON numeric color IDs decoded as floats. Known color IDs now normalize to integers, unknown values remain preserved; replacement fresh process passes 9/9.
ODR-DEV-OPEN-INTEGRATION-20261103 from origin/dev supersedes the earlier demo integration freeze. Normal probes-green topic integration applies.

Complete first local suite exits 1 solely for three Bubble Duel checks that required unchanged file bytes. New owner-commissioned purchases intentionally persist. Diagnostic changed-key list is only save_file_sha256. Other practice surfaces retain their unchanged-file check; Bubble Duel additionally verifies saved wallet and semantic story/career data.
Complete frozen recheck passed all 82 with zero process exits; source patch and feature hashes unchanged. This does not grant formal visual, device, child or owner acceptance.
capture_binding_note: Thirty-seven normal-aspect captures refreshed after final replay, mode-context and movement-seam corrections. Eight earlier alternate-aspect views show unchanged idle Duel/shop states. All 45 file hashes verified. These are diagnostic views, not canonical fresh-runtime evidence.
device_check: 2026-11-04: adb devices -l reports no connected devices; no physical Android acceptance claimed.
frozen_verification: Final 100 tours / 1301 checks, new process 9/9 reload checks, and final 100 physics bouts run against these unchanged gameplay source hashes.

weights_before_after: At most 100 ms in 16.7 ms steps
physics_comparison.interpretation: The moderate profile provides reliable contact with reduced landing guidance and bounded hitch steps. Automated completion/contact criteria support this choice; child preference and subjective feel remain unmeasured.

capture_isolation: Both review probes now bind OS.get_user_data_dir() to the explicitly supplied isolated root before creating ReefMain. Mismatched capture root exits 2 before fixture credits; correct root renders four smoke captures. See evidence/capture-guard-negative.log and capture-guard-positive.log.
local_suite_source_limit: The second complete local run used unchanged final feature code, verified by its frozen runtime patch and eight source bindings. The preceding mixed-stage/obsolete-SHA failure remains historical evidence. Exact published-head CI is still required before dev integration.
